output.summary: Red alga with no stated native origin, found on both sides of the northern Atlantic. It forms perennial tufts of wiry, irregularly branching reddish-black fronds attached to rock. It can be eaten raw or cooked and is described as crunchy and pleasant-tasting.
output.edibilityNote: Edible seaweed eaten raw or cooked; it was also used in the Soviet Union to produce agar.
